guscent.title: Guscent
guscent.summary: A design-led perfume storefront that helps customers discover products through mood-based storytelling, a scent quiz, editorial content, and a polished commerce journey.

highlights.storefront: Built the production Next.js storefront from the designer's direction, with reusable sections for product discovery and brand storytelling.
highlights.quiz: Implemented an interactive scent quiz that turns customer moods and preferences into a guided fragrance-discovery journey.
highlights.commerce: Delivered catalog navigation, product presentation, and shopping-cart interactions across the customer journey.
highlights.api: Integrated backend APIs and CMS-driven media/content with resilient loading, empty, and error states.
highlights.responsive: Translated a highly visual design into a responsive, accessible experience across desktop, tablet, and mobile.
highlights.collaboration: Owned the frontend in a three-person freelance team, working closely with one backend developer and one designer.

uctalent.title: uctalent.io
uctalent.summary: HRTech platform: talent marketplace on uctalent.io and a React workspace for head hunters on business.uctalent.io — AI matching, semantic search, blockchain referrals.

highlights.hunterPortal: Built business.uctalent.io — a React app for head hunters to source candidates, run pipelines, and close placements.
highlights.fullstack: Shipped production full-stack features across uctalent.io and the hunter workspace with Next.js, NestJS, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
highlights.hrAi: Applied LLMs to HR workflows — resume screening, job–candidate matching, and outreach drafts that cut recruiter busywork.
highlights.elasticsearch: Indexed jobs and talent profiles on Elasticsearch for fast, faceted search at platform scale.
highlights.semantic: Combined Elasticsearch with vector embeddings for semantic search and recommendations beyond keyword matching.
highlights.microservices: Designed GraphQL + Redis + async job integrations across microservices so matching, search, and notifications stay resilient.
highlights.ddd: Designed backend services with Clean Architecture and Domain-Driven Design for long-term maintainability.
highlights.performance: Improved performance via API, query, and Redis caching optimization plus code reviews.

unchainlabs.title: Unchain Labs
unchainlabs.summary: Enterprise marketing site and headless CMS for Unchain Labs — content-managed pages, full SEO, and contact flows for business leads.

highlights.cms: Built a Strapi headless CMS with structured content types, media library, and role-based admin for marketing teams.
highlights.seo: Implemented end-to-end SEO — metadata, Open Graph, sitemap, robots, and semantic HTML for crawlable business pages.
highlights.contact: Shipped contact and lead-capture flows with validated forms and reliable delivery for inbound business inquiries.
highlights.content: Modeled flexible page sections and reusable components so non-developers can publish case studies, services, and blog posts.
highlights.fullstack: Delivered a Next.js frontend consuming Strapi REST APIs with SSR for performance and indexable marketing content.
highlights.delivery: Deployed production builds with environment-based config, image optimization, and maintainable content workflows.
highlights.responsive: Built a responsive Tailwind CSS interface that keeps the marketing experience polished across desktop, tablet, and mobile.
highlights.architecture: Separated the presentation layer from CMS-driven data so new pages and campaigns can be assembled without reworking the frontend.

matchtutors.title: Match Tutors
matchtutors.summary: Personal capstone platform that connects tutors and students — scheduling, AI-assisted matching, realtime chat, and payments.

highlights.platform: Built a tutor–student connection product end-to-end: profiles, scheduling, and learning management flows.
highlights.matching: Implemented AI-assisted matching with OpenAI embeddings and background match workers on Redis/BullMQ.
highlights.realtime: Added realtime messaging and live updates with Socket.io across the booking experience.
highlights.workers: Designed async job workers for embeddings, email, notifications, and match processing.
highlights.payments: Integrated PayOS checkout plus auth (JWT / Google OAuth) and file uploads (S3 / Cloudinary).
highlights.fullstack: Shipped React + Vite frontend and Express + MongoDB API as separate repos — production builds deployed on AWS, with Cloudinary for image and file storage.
highlights.scheduling: Delivered scheduling flows that let tutors and students coordinate lessons and manage the learning journey in one place.
highlights.auth: Implemented secure access with JWT and Google OAuth so each user can safely manage their profile, bookings, and payments.
